newsitem.title: USA: ALPINE SKIING - PROFILE OF SABINA PANZANINI.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING - PROFILE OF SABINA PANZANINI.

text.p: Following is a brief profile of Sabina Panzanini, winner of the World Cup giant slalom in Park City, Utah, on Thursday:
World Cup victories: One, Alta Badia, Italy, 1994

Other: A terror on long, difficult courses, winning on an Alta Badia track considered demanding for men, as well as finishing runnerup on similarly tough courses at Narvik, Norway, and Park City. Scored her first World Cup points as a late bloomer in 1993 but now has reached the podium seven times.
